jobs.title: Associate IT Support Analyst
jobs.why: This role builds your Customer and Personal Service, Troubleshooting, Administrative skills and moves you toward becoming a Software Engineer.
jobs.eligibility_reason: IT support analyst, no age restrictions.
jobs.bridge: As an Associate IT Support Analyst, you'll deepen your troubleshooting and customer-service skills while gaining hands-on experience with hardware, software, and IT service desk operations—all directly transferable to a Software Engineer or Developer role, where understanding system-level issues and user needs is critical.

jobs.title: IT Support Technician
jobs.why: This role builds your Customer and Personal Service, Troubleshooting, Administrative skills and moves you toward becoming a Software Engineer.
jobs.bridge: Your IT Support Technician role hones troubleshooting, hardware, and software skills that are directly transferable to software engineering, while building customer service and coordination abilities that set you apart as a developer who understands user needs.

jobs.title: IT Support Technician - Saturday - Tuesday
jobs.why: This role builds your Customer and Personal Service, Troubleshooting, Administrative skills and moves you toward becoming a Software Engineer.
jobs.bridge: Your IT Support Technician role sharpens your troubleshooting and customer service skills while building deep expertise in hardware, software, and policy compliance—all directly transferable to software engineering and development, where debugging and user-focused solutions are key.

jobs.title: Support Engineer
jobs.why: This role builds your Customer and Personal Service, Troubleshooting, Administrative skills and moves you toward becoming a Software Engineer.
jobs.bridge: As a Support Engineer, you'll deepen your troubleshooting and process-improvement skills, which are directly transferable to software development. Automating tasks and managing tickets also builds the technical and coordination abilities that will help you transition into a Software Engineer or Developer role.

jobs.title: Veterinary Client Service Representative (CSR)
jobs.why: This role builds your Customer and Personal Service, Troubleshooting, Administrative skills and moves you toward becoming a Software Engineer.
jobs.bridge: Your role as a Veterinary CSR hones communication, troubleshooting, and coordination skills that are directly transferable to IT support and software development, where you'll need to diagnose issues, manage client relations, and organize workflows. This practical experience in a fast-paced healthcare setting will make you a standout candidate for tech roles that value clear communication and problem-solving.

skill_path: Your strong foundation in customer service, troubleshooting, and bilingual skills makes you an ideal candidate for IT support roles. By building bridge skills in hardware support and incident management, and then adding Windows expertise and automation, you'll be well on your way to becoming an IT Support Specialist or even a Software Engineer!

steps: Complete a Windows troubleshooting course (e.g., Microsoft Learn's Windows Fundamentals)
Practice end-user support scenarios via a help desk simulation or volunteer IT support
Learn basic automation scripting with PowerShell or Python (e.g., Automate the Boring Stuff)
Create documentation for a common IT process and share with peers to build knowledge-sharing skills
Apply for an entry-level IT support role to gain hands-on experience with incident management and tech ops
skill_tree.summary: Your strong foundation in customer service, troubleshooting, and bilingual skills makes you an ideal candidate for IT support roles. By building bridge skills in hardware support and incident management, and then adding Windows expertise and automation, you'll be well on your way to becoming an IT Support Specialist or even a Software Engineer!
